sourceSentences: [0] Every time you hit a champion or blaster or minion with Q, you gain one stack. The stacks increases Smolder's damage of his basic abilities, while also evolving Q at 25, 125, and 225 stacks.
[0] 225 is Smolder's most important threshold because at 225, you will start executing enemies below a certain amount of HP, while also applying a percent max health burn to them.
[0] Smolder's E, flap flap flap, is your main movement ability that gives you bonus movement speed and lets you fly over walls while also shooting the lowest health enemy near you.
[0] Smolder's R, mom, it's a rectangular ability that goes in a straight line which heals you while also doing critical damage and slowing enemies if you hit enemies in the center.
[0] Early game. Smolder's early game is bad, but who's shocked? Your mango should be to get 25 stacks to unlock your AoE Q, which makes you a lot more annoying to lane versus
